description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml, which extends XMLWriter to convert HTMLPurifier configuration schemas into XML format for documentation purposes. It includes methods to build XML documents representing configuration namespaces, directives, and descriptions, incorporating HTML sanitization and structured output.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml
classes.description: A class that converts HTMLPurifier configuration schemas into an XML format suitable for documentation, extending PHP's XMLWriter.

methods.name: writeHTMLDiv
methods.description: Sanitizes HTML content with HTMLPurifier and writes it within a 'div' element in the XML document.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports a variable to a string representation, handling empty arrays specifically.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an XML document representing the entire configuration schema based on the interchange object.

methods.name: buildNamespace
methods.description: Converts a namespace object into an XML element, including its description and directives.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: Converts a directive object into an XML element, including its constraints, allowed values, description, and deprecation info.
